title: Crash in QQuickItemGrabResult::render when double-clicking a folder in a panel Folder View popup (list mode)
line: Double-clicking a folder in a panel Folder View popup in list mode no longer crashes or freezes Plasma.
explanation: Every selection change in Folder View immediately starts grabbing drag images of the selected rows (onSelectionDone: main.generateDragImage()). The release of a double-click re-selects the folder, which starts a grab of its row, and the same click then opens the folder, whose model reset deletes that row while the render thread is still rendering the grab. The render thread then posts an event to the freed grab result and plasmashell crashes, or freezes when it locks a freed mutex. The change defers drag image generation with Qt.callLater, so it runs after the folder has been opened and only grabs rows that still exist.

commits.message:
containments/desktop: fix crash when opening a folder in a popup

Double-clicking a folder in a list-mode popup grabbed the drag image of
the clicked row right before opening the folder deleted it, so the grab
could finish on a deleted item. Generate drag images with Qt.callLater.

BUG: 527739

patches.diff:
From 7d05d982ede487cf496777d173f8bd8820a4a4cf Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 17:14:41 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] containments/desktop: fix crash when opening a folder in a
 popup

Double-clicking a folder in a list-mode popup grabbed the drag image of
the clicked row right before opening the folder deleted it, so the grab
could finish on a deleted item. Generate drag images with Qt.callLater.

BUG: 527739
---
 containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/FolderView.qml | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/FolderView.qml b/containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/FolderView.qml
index b858d16f7a..4cd87425dd 100644
--- a/containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/FolderView.qml
+++ b/containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/FolderView.qml
@@ -1244,7 +1244,7 @@ FocusScope {
             // Create drag images before dragging
             // Due to async operations we can't call this before dragging starts,
             // but we have to call it after a selection is done
-            onSelectionDone: main.generateDragImage()
+            onSelectionDone: Qt.callLater(main.generateDragImage)
 
             onListingCompleted: {
                 if (!gridView.model && root.expanded) {
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Master: Back / double-click Documents in the list-mode popup; plasmashell crashes at round 8 (popup and panel vanish).
With the fix: the same loop runs 25 rounds without a crash (175 rounds in total).
Master, first double-click on Documents: plasmashell froze (render thread stuck in QQuickItemGrabResult::render); the popup never updates.
With the fix: the double-click opens Documents.
With the fix: dragging Downloads out of the popup still shows its drag image and the drop menu.

review.text: Deferring onSelectionDone with Qt.callLater(main.generateDragImage) is a fragile timing workaround that regresses fast drags and leaves part of the crash race open. Because FolderView.qml relies on generateDragImage() running synchronously during onPressed to set pressedItem.dragImageBeingGenerated = true before onPositionChanged checks it (commit 7fa1f08f1a for bug 527529), deferring onSelectionDone allows a fast same-frame press-and-drag of an unselected icon to start with no drag image. It also still leaves the QQuickItemGrabResult::render crash reachable whenever a grab started on press has not finished before doCd() resets the model (e.g. fast double-clicks or single-click activation).
changes: Do not defer all onSelectionDone drag image generation with Qt.callLater, so pressedItem.dragImageBeingGenerated remains set synchronously on press and fast drags of unselected icons do not lose their drag image.

Avoid the redundant dir.clearSelection() + dir.setSelected() re-selection in listener.onReleased when hoveredItem is already the sole selected item (or avoid re-selecting right before onClicked activates/navigates), which is what triggers the spurious grab immediately before doCd().

Guard FolderView's doCd() against resetting the model while a delegate's grabToImage (dragImageBeingGenerated) is still in flight so press-initiated grabs cannot crash on fast double-clicks or single-click mode, and reference an upstream Qt bug for the underlying QQuickItemGrabResult::render UAF.

reviews.text: The diagnosis is right (onReleased's setSelected starts a grab of the row that onClicked's doCd deletes in the same event, and QQuickItemGrabResult then touches the freed result), and deferring with Qt.callLater does push the release-path grab past the cd; the 175-round stress loop is convincing. But selectionDone is also emitted on press, and cwo's 6.8.3 fast-drag fix relies on updateDragImage() setting dragImageBeingGenerated synchronously so onPositionChanged waits for the image. With the deferral, a press plus a threshold-crossing move processed in the same batch of input events starts dragSelected() before the grab is even requested (and the queued callLater runs just before dragSelectedInternal, too early for grabToImage to finish), bringing back the 'newly selected icon vanishes while dragging' case. after-3 only shows a normal-speed drag, so this is unverified.
changes: Keep the 'image is being generated' state synchronous: e.g. on selectionDone mark the selected delegates' dragImageBeingGenerated immediately and defer only the grabToImage call (or defer only the release-path regeneration), so a drag can't start before the image exists.

Verify cwo's fast-drag case on the fixed build: press an unselected desktop icon and flick it in one burst of moves (as in 527529's test) and confirm the drag image is shown; also re-run the double-click/Back stress loop.
Mention in the commit message that the underlying unsafety is in Qt (QQuickItemGrabResult with an item deleted mid-render), ideally with a QTBUG link.
